Term1: Prevention of infection in patients with nasal packing
Text:
# PREVENTION OF INFECTION IN PATIENTS WITH NASAL PACKING

Antimicrobial prophylaxis to prevent infection and toxic shock syndrome in patients with nasal packing is not recommended. Antibiotics increase the risk of adverse events in patients with nasal packing with no proven effectiveness in preventing infection.
